findings.title: Edge 403 for several AI crawlers while robots.txt only advises
findings.description: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, Claude-Web, CCBot, Bytespider and Amazonbot get 403 from Cloudflare; the managed robots.txt and the enforcement do not match.
findings.recommendation: Owner action: align Cloudflare Block AI bots, AI Crawl Control and Managed robots.txt with the intended policy.

findings.title: HTML s-maxage of one year (latent)
findings.description: Prerendered HTML carries s-maxage=31536000; safe today because each deploy replaces it and Cloudflare does not cache Worker HTML.
findings.recommendation: Deferred: changing it needs revalidate, which is forbidden. Never enable a Cache Everything rule for HTML.
